## Which is which

- The **calibrated probability** is the **catalogue-based** one (the LBNL/NCEDC March 2016 catalogue, GDR 859, with assumed b-values 1.0/0.73/0.65): P(Mw ≥ 5.5) of order **10⁻⁴–10⁻² per year** depending on b.
